LEAVE AND LICENCE AGREEMENT

This Leave and Licence Agreement is made on 1 March 2026 between Mr. Anil Kulkarni, residing at Kalyani Nagar, Pune, Maharashtra 411006 (hereinafter referred to as the "Licensor") and Ms. Sara Khan, residing at Baner, Pune, Maharashtra 411045 (hereinafter referred to as the "Licensee").

1. Licensed Premises
The Licensor grants the Licensee a licence to occupy Flat No. 402, Sunrise Residency, Baner, Pune, solely for residential use, for a period of eleven (11) months commencing on 1 March 2026.

2. Licence Fee
The Licensee shall pay a monthly licence fee of Rs. 45,000 on or before the fifth day of each month. Any payment delayed beyond seven (7) days shall attract interest at 18% per annum on the overdue amount, and the fee shall increase by 10% on renewal.

3. Security Deposit
The Licensee has paid an interest-free refundable security deposit of Rs. 2,25,000. The Licensor may deduct from the deposit any amount for damage, unpaid dues, or repainting charges at his sole discretion, and any amount not refunded within sixty (60) days of vacating may be treated as forfeited.

4. Lock-in Period
Neither party may terminate this Agreement during the first six (6) months (the lock-in period). If the Licensee vacates during the lock-in period, the Licensee shall pay the licence fee for the remainder of the lock-in period as liquidated damages.

5. Termination and Notice
After the lock-in period, either party may terminate this Agreement by giving thirty (30) days prior written notice.

6. Use Restrictions
The Licensee shall not sublet the premises, run a business from the premises, or keep pets without the prior written consent of the Licensor.

7. Indemnity
The Licensee shall indemnify the Licensor against all claims, losses and damages arising from the Licensee's use of the premises.

8. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. The courts at Pune, Maharashtra shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of this Agreement.
